mapper.sql: id, client_request_id, content, reference_at, zone_id, status, error_message, attempt_count, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, revertible
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO capture_inputs (id, client_request_id, content, source, captured_at, reference_at, zone_id, status, processing_token, lease_expires_at, revertible) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, #{content}, 'AI', #{referenceAt}, #{referenceAt}, #{zoneId}, 'PROCESSING', #{token}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (client_request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM capture_inputs WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE capture_inputs SET status='PROCESSING', error_message=NULL, completed_at=NULL, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, processing_token=#{token}, lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'

UPDATE capture_inputs SET status='FAILED', error_message=#{message}, completed_at=#{now}, processing_token=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_records (id, project_id, content, occurred_at, capture_input_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{content}, #{occurredAt}, #{inputId})
INSERT INTO todo_items (id, project_id, title, notes, due_at, priority, capture_input_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{notes}, #{dueAt}, #{priority}, #{inputId})
INSERT INTO capture_generated_items (input_id, entity_type, entity_id, initial_version) VALUES (#{inputId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{initialVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM capture_generated_items WHERE input_id=#{inputId} AND entity_type=#{entityType}

SELECT count(*) FROM capture_generated_items gi JOIN work_records wr ON wr.id=gi.entity_id WHERE gi.input_id=#{inputId} AND gi.entity_type='RECORD' AND wr.capture_input_id=gi.input_id AND wr.version=gi.initial_version AND wr.is_active AND wr.source='MANUAL'

SELECT count(*) FROM capture_generated_items gi JOIN todo_items t ON t.id=gi.entity_id WHERE gi.input_id=#{inputId} AND gi.entity_type='TASK' AND t.capture_input_id=gi.input_id AND t.version=gi.initial_version AND t.status='PENDING' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE work_records SET is_active=FALSE, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE capture_input_id=#{inputId} AND is_active AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM capture_generated_items gi WHERE gi.input_id=#{inputId} AND gi.entity_type='RECORD' AND gi.entity_id=work_records.id AND gi.initial_version=work_records.version )

UPDATE todo_items SET deleted_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE capture_input_id=#{inputId} AND status='PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM capture_generated_items gi WHERE gi.input_id=#{inputId} AND gi.entity_type='TASK' AND gi.entity_id=todo_items.id AND gi.initial_version=todo_items.version )
UPDATE capture_inputs SET status='REVERTED', updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='SUCCEEDED'
mapper.select: SELECT wr.id, wr.project_id, p.name project_name, wr.content, wr.occurred_at FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=wr.project_id WHERE wr.capture_input_id=#{inputId} ORDER BY wr.created_at, wr.id

SELECT t.id, t.project_id, p.name project_name, t.title, t.notes, t.due_at, t.priority, t.version FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id WHERE t.capture_input_id=#{inputId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id
